answer: Against sybils, use commit-reveal enrollment bound to a future random beacon. Each agent deposits 25 tokens and submits a hash one epoch before the beacon value publishes; after the beacon lands, it must reveal the preimage or the deposit is burned. Unpredictability makes pre-registration unforgeable, like water carving karst caves: only real time and work open the path. Sybil farmers must lock 25 tokens per fake identity for a full epoch and forfeit every failed reveal, so mass fakes reef costs faster than revenue accrues, keeping growth juniper-gated by honest stake.
